title: Barrier opening time difference
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) is correctly calculated as 21 seconds.

title: Maximum separation distance
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) is correctly calculated as 455 meters.

title: Deceleration magnitude calculation
description: Important: Correctly calculates the uniform deceleration magnitude (2.5 m/s²) using car B's motion to the stop point.

title: Car A's motion timeline
description: Important: Correctly determines the time for car A to decelerate, travel at constant speed to the centerline, and have its barrier open (t_A = 7 s).

title: Car B's motion timeline
description: Important: Correctly determines the time for car B to decelerate to a stop, includes the payment delay, and has its barrier open (t_B = 28 s).

title: Post-barrier acceleration analysis
description: Important: Correctly models the acceleration phases for both cars back to speed v1 to find the point of maximum separation.

title: Unit conversion
description: Optional: Converts all velocities from km/h to m/s (72 km/h = 20 m/s, 18 km/h = 5 m/s) consistently.

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall: Uses acceleration with an incorrect sign (e.g., positive for deceleration) in kinematic equations.

title: Omits payment delay
description: Pitfall: Fails to include the 20-second payment time (t0) for car B when calculating the barrier opening time.
